QuestInfo.name: Demoralizing the Aliens
QuestInfo.0: Show the aliens how many brave Maplers there are in Maple World! For every hour you're online, OSSS will issue you #b#t04310004##k.
QuestInfo.1: Since OSSS will be issuing you #b#t04310004##k every hour you're logged in, you should stay connected and not log off.
QuestInfo.2: You received #b#t04310004##k for staying online for an hour. Good job doing your part to scare away the aliens!

0.0: I've been thinking... If the aliens realized how united Maplers are, they might think twice about invading.
0.1: #bSo for every hour that passes while you are logged in#k, the OSSS will recognize your effort and issue you 1 #b#t04310004#.
0.2: When one hour has passed, the 0 Minute Timer that you've been issued will turn into a 60 Minute Timer. When that occurs, please exchange it for a #b#t04310004##k.
0.3: The #b#t04310004##k can be used to purchase cells to upgrade your suit. Just talk to #b#p9250135##k.
0.4: Having enough medals is very important, so don't miss out on any medals.

yes.0: Good luck.\r\nRemember that the future of Maple World is in your hands.

no.0: Who then will stand up for Maple World...?

1.0: The Timer has changed to 60 minutes.
